evidence_registry.REQ-1: Requirement: fixed 50 km2 environment must exist before people.
evidence_registry.REQ-2: Requirement: closed boundary with rainfall input and output-only drainage.
evidence_registry.REQ-3: Requirement: water, food, shelter, fire, tools and stable supply dependency chains.
evidence_registry.REQ-4: Requirement: food must be tested by season, access, knowledge, processing and regeneration.
evidence_registry.REQ-5: Requirement: population age, kinship, care, skill and experience must be coherent.
evidence_registry.REQ-6: Requirement: dispersal, exploration and settlement remain person-driven.

climate.rationale: A fixed temperate floodplain climate is used for the Phase 1 validation run.

hydrology.rationale: All water is generated within the closed world; rainfall is the only water input and evaporation is an output.

resources.toxicity: Low when correctly identified; discard spoiled tissue and uncertain look-alikes.
Tubers are starch-rich; all other plant parts are not treated as food.
resources.reproduction: Tubers and seed heads; wet soil required for establishment.

resources.toxicity: Only ripe fruits of verified local species; unknown berries are rejected.
resources.reproduction: Seed and vegetative spread; several species share the same seasonal window.

resources.toxicity: Low after shelling; discard mouldy nuts.
Raw tannins require repeated leaching; mouldy or sprouted nuts are rejected.
resources.reproduction: Masting with animal and gravity dispersal; heavy crops are irregular.

resources.toxicity: Only verified edible greens; bitter or milky unknown plants are rejected.
Raw freshwater fish carries parasite risk; cooking is preferred.
resources.reproduction: Spawn and juvenile survival within the closed lake and wetland system.

resources.toxicity: Cook meat and eggs; handling risk is included in processing time.
Cook meat thoroughly; capture injury remains possible.
Cook meat; field dressing failures increase spoilage.
resources.reproduction: Low reproductive rate; local depletion persists after heavy harvest.
